story.title: Story 1: Attach Repositories to a Project or Process

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on closing SV-01 and SV-02 by checking the newly added project/process attach UI actions, browser API wiring, immediate surface refresh behavior, and the expanded process current-source contract/rendering. I also re-checked the Story 1 regression evidence for duplicate blocking, null-target duplicate handling, invalid/inaccessible no-partial-row rejection, and process current-source mutation, then reran the story and epic gates.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: The project shell and process work surface now both expose real attach forms via the shared composer (apps/platform/client/features/projects/source-attachment-composer.ts:15-127), wired into the project shell and process work-surface renderers (apps/platform/client/features/projects/source-attachment-section.ts:14-58, apps/platform/client/features/projects/project-shell-page.ts:83-101, apps/platform/client/features/processes/process-materials-section.ts:48-70, apps/platform/client/features/processes/process-work-surface-page.ts:214-228). Bootstrap now calls the real POST routes through browser API wrappers and immediately refetches the active shell/surface after create (apps/platform/client/browser-api/projects-api.ts:108-127, apps/platform/client/browser-api/process-work-surface-api.ts:233-256, apps/platform/client/app/bootstrap.ts:1636-1709). Client tests cover the project-shell and process-surface attach submissions (tests/service/client/project-shell-page.test.ts:125-180, tests/service/client/process-work-surface-page.test.ts:559-602).

Process currentSources now carry repositoryFullName and attachmentScope in the shared contract (apps/platform/shared/contracts/process-work-surface.ts:319-333), the materials reader projects both fields from durable source attachments (apps/platform/server/services/processes/readers/materials-section.reader.ts:80-101), and the process materials UI renders Repository and Scope details for each current source (apps/platform/client/features/processes/process-materials-section.ts:236-253). The refreshed process attach API expectation now requires both fields after create (tests/service/server/source-management-api.test.ts:222-236), and client rendering tests assert that the process surface shows repository identity and scope (tests/service/client/process-materials-section.test.ts:45-57, tests/service/client/process-work-surface-page.test.ts:537-557).

additionalObservations: The regression evidence remains intact: duplicate exact attachment blocking is still covered in tests/service/server/source-management-api.test.ts:241-285, missing-target-ref duplicate handling is still covered in convex/sourceAttachments.test.ts:288-327, invalid/inaccessible no-partial-row rejection is still covered in tests/service/server/source-management-api.test.ts:288-360, and process current-source mutation is still evidenced by tests/service/server/source-management-api.test.ts:182-238.

The story markdown still contains a documentation-level contract ambiguity: the Create Response table describes a {"sourceAttachment": ...} wrapper, while Flow 1, the route schemas, browser API wrappers, and tests all use a bare SourceAttachmentSummary. I did not treat that as blocking because the implemented/server-tested contract is internally consistent and the required gates passed.
Epic gate output still shows the repo-baseline e2e scaffold message (test:e2e prints SKIP), which did not block verify-all.
